sync.title: Sync data
sync.subtitle: Import your Scriptable JSON files
sync.pwa_title: Install the app for automatic sync
sync.pwa_body: In Safari, tap Share → "Add to Home Screen". Once installed, you can share JSONs directly from Scriptable with no extra steps.
sync.error_processing: Error processing files. Check they are valid JSONs.
sync.stale_title: Your data may be out of date
sync.mode_manual_desc: Share your JSON files to the app as usual. Nothing leaves your device.
sync.mode_relay_desc: The app fetches your data automatically on launch. It's end-to-end encrypted: the relay only stores unreadable ciphertext.
sync.relay_pass_hint: Use the same passphrase here and in Scriptable. It never leaves your devices.
sync.relay_empty: Nothing published to the relay yet
sync.relay_need_pass: The passphrase must be at least 6 characters
sync.relay_err_network: Couldn't reach the relay. Check the URL and your connection.
sync.relay_activated_hint: Opening Scriptable to set up this device… When it's done, come back and tap Sync now.
sync.relay_backup_warn: Store this in your notes or password manager. You'll need it to restore if you reinstall or clear the app.
sync.relay_restore_hint: Paste the backup config you saved to restore it on this device.
sync.gaps_desc: These days have no data, but you were clearly in the same country right before and after. Want to fill them in?
sync.filled_desc: Days you added by hand. You can change the country or remove them if it was a mistake.
sync.patches_apply_hint: Writes your repairs back into your JSON files via Scriptable. Otherwise they apply automatically next time the widget records a day.
sync.patches_unsaved: You have unsaved repairs — apply them on your iPhone to make them permanent.
sync.patches_preparing_hint: Syncing your change to the relay… you'll be able to apply it in a moment.
sync.disable_body: This stops pulling from the relay, deletes the encrypted copy stored there, and removes the sync keys from this iPhone. Your local data stays, and you can re-enable it later.
